issues.description: Wrong page shown: the test expects a marketing landing page at the root URL but the browser is on /dashboard showing the authenticated dashboard. The current URL is http://localhost:3000/dashboard, not http://localhost:3000/.
issues.root_cause: The test is navigating to /dashboard instead of the root / landing page, or the root route redirects to /dashboard. This is a routing/test-setup issue, not necessarily a code bug in the landing page itself.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated 7 times and 'entire root will switch to client rendering'. Caused by dynamic content (like dates/times or greeting) being rendered differently on server vs client.
issues.element: Dashboard page - likely the greeting 'Good evening, Amelia.' or date display
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx, the greeting (Good morning/afternoon/evening) or date string is computed at render time using new Date() or Date.now(), which differs between SSR and client hydration. The time-based greeting changes between server render and client mount.

issues.description: ReferenceError: 'setIsMounted is not defined' repeated 14+ times in page errors. This indicates a missing useState declaration for isMounted in one or more components.
issues.element: Component using setIsMounted without declaring it via useState
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-7c/page.tsx (referenced in stack trace at line 108), setIsMounted is called but the corresponding const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false) declaration is missing or was accidentally deleted.

fixes.reason: Prevents hydration mismatch by returning a consistent value during SSR. The greeting won't differ between server and client initial render.
